Tong2025: Geometric/magnetic quasi-static benchmark is usable; a fully sourced dynamic benchmark still lacks actual density and damping.
Do not use neat Sylgard 184 vendor density for unknown-loading NdFeB composite.
For two-mode reduction, retain distributed magnetic potential -integral_(L-Lm)^L Mline*(B0*cos(theta(s))+By*sin(theta(s))) ds unless a nearly rigid magnetized-segment approximation is justified.
Its linear magnetic stiffness is B0*Mline*integral b(s)b(s)^T ds, generally not the rank-one terminal point-dipole stiffness.
A clamped-free no-contact, fixed-length two-mode model is an explicitly newly defined benchmark variation.
Changing geometry, stiffness, mass or magnetization requires recomputing modal coefficients.
Francescon2025: Reinforced Ecoflex/NdFeB device is not a uniform isotropic Sylgard beam.
Effective bending/twisting moduli must not be inserted into isotropic E=2G(1+nu).
Spatially programmed full-body magnetization is not a terminal point dipole.
Uniform Helmholtz control demonstrates torque control; it does not establish independent magnetic-gradient force control.
field_design: 30 mT bias plus 6 mT transverse needs 30.594 mT total magnitude.
30 mT bias plus 20 mT transverse needs 36.056 mT total magnitude.
If a rating is single-axis only, simultaneous orthogonal currents and resultant norm require separate validation.
40 mT capacity has primary experimental evidence, but does not prove any intended combined gradient command, workspace trajectory or bandwidth feasible.

decision: Tong and Francescon each supply partial, coherent facts but neither inspected article supplies all inertial/dissipative quantities for the current dynamic point-dipole two-mode model. Do not splice their unrelated material properties into one purportedly reproduced device.
